title: SmartStock
desc: Inventory app built with a four-person Agile team. Developed the Next.js and Tailwind frontend, integrated a Python Flask REST API, and implemented JWT-based role checks and protected routes to enforce user permissions.

title: JobMatch
desc:
TypeScript and Next.js app for tailoring resumes and assessing job fit with the OpenAI API.
Validates AI responses with Zod and automatically retries invalid outputs.
Automates resume tailoring and job matching with processing times under one minute.
tech: TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, OpenAI API, Zod

title: Fragments Microservice
desc:
Node.js and Express REST API on AWS for signing in, saving small pieces of data, and retrieving them later.
Restricts reads and writes to each authenticated owner, with scoped IAM permissions for S3 and DynamoDB.
Containerized with Docker; GitHub Actions runs builds and tests before deployment.
tech: Node.js, Express, AWS (IAM, DynamoDB, S3), Docker

title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
desc:
Trains a simulated self-driving car
using CNNs and reinforcement learning.

title: AI Emotion Detector
desc:
Lightweight CNN facial-emotion recognition
trained on FER2013, with a real-time labeled feed
and a growing sample corpus for training a
triplet-loss classifier against the cascade baseline.

title: Gaming Laptop Recommender
desc:
Automated scraper collecting live specs for 1,000+ gaming laptops
from major retailers, holding roughly 90% collection success as
those sites change, by using a separate configuration per retailer.
A chat front end recommends laptops by budget and intended use.
